question: Who among the following is the brand ambassador of Entri, a local learning app for jobs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robin Uthappa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robin Uthappa**__ is appointed as the brand ambassador of Entri, a local learning app for jobs.
 
• 'Entri' is a local language learning app for jobs based in **Kerala.**
 
• **Mohammed Hisamuddin** is the founder and Chief Executive Officer of Entri application.
 
• Entri started in 2017 from Kerala with Malayalam content and has since launched Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, and Hindi content.
 
• **Robin Uthappa** is a cricketer from India who represents Kerala in domestic cricket.
 __
 
• He was a part of the Indian cricket squad that won the ICC World Twenty20 Championship in 2007.
 
• In the IPL, Robin Uthappa currently plays for Chennai Super Kings.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rohit Sharma **is the first non-footballer to become the brand ambassador of La Liga in India.
 
• **M C Mary Kom** is the brand ambassador of the TRIFED Aadi Mahotsav.
 
• **Sania Mirza** was appointed brand ambassador of Telangana in 2014.
